assets.title: Desktop Handmic Transceiver
assets.description: One original static desktop communications appearance, counted as one prop. A low wide closed thick hollow teal shell has a sloping front, six true through-wall top slots and a distinct internal thick baffle separated from every slot by a complete air chamber. A recessed dark screen, large faceted tuning-style knob and five finite controls rest on the front. Four separate finite feet support the main body. A thick side U-shaped open cradle supports one upright flattened handmic on a finite lower face, with real shallow open sound slots and a fixed side pad; the remaining cradle clearance is empty. A single closed thick short lead connects the front socket to the mic underside with three separated turns and continuous curved strain-relief ends. Every component is fixed and the complete assembly is one prop. Metres, native Z up, front -Y, horizontally bounds-centred ground origin. No textures, antenna, table, person, extra wiring scene, old portable-radio widening, extracted microphone or old console conversion. Static visual geometry only: no transmit/receive, audio, power, band, protocol, signal/electrical continuity, ventilation, plugging, microphone or control operation, cable elasticity, ergonomics, manufacturing, material suitability, electrical/RF/install safety or certification claim. No compatibility claim with old antennas, handhelds or cradles.
